3008:
**λειτουργέω**, -ῶ
(λειτουργός), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁרַת pi., also for עָבַד, צָבָא, etc. ;] 
1. in cl., at Athens, to supply public offices at one's own cost, render public service to the State, hence, generally, 
2. **to serve the State, do a service, serve **(of service to the Gods, Diod., i, 21): of the official service of priests and Levites ([[02-exodus.29.30|Exo.29:30]], [[04-numbers.16.9|Num.16:9]], Sir.4:14, 1Ma.10:42, al.; cf. Deiss., BS, 140 f.), [[58-hebrews.10.11|Heb.10:11;]] of Christians: with dative of person(s) before ἐν, [[45-romans.15.27|Rom.15:27]] (cf. Sir.10:25); τ. κυρίῳ, [[44-acts.13.2|Act.13:2.]]
_SYN._: λατρεύω (which see), prop., to serve for hire, LXX (as some­times in cl.), always of service to the deity on the part of both priests and people ([[02-exodus.4.3|Exo.4:3]], [[05-deuteronomy.10.12|Deu.10:12]], and similarly in NT). λειτουργέω "is the fulfilment of an office: it has a definite representative character, and corresponds with a function to be discharged". It is therefore used of serving in an office or ministry: in LXX always of priests and Levites, in NT, with its cognates ([[45-romans.13.6|Rom.13:6 15:27]], are not really exceptions), of services rendered either to God or man by apostles, prophets, teachers, and other officers of the church (cf. Tr., _Syn._, § xxxv; _ICC_ on [[45-romans.1.9|Rom.1:9;]] Westc., He., 232 ff.) (AS)

(AS)

3303:
**μέν**, 
_conjunctive particle_ (originally a form of μήν), usually related to a following δέ or other adversative conjunction, and distinguishing the word or clause with which it stands from that which follows. 
It is generally untranslatable and is not nearly so frequent in NT as in cl. Like δέ, it never stands first in a clause. 
1. **Answered by δέ or some other particle**: μὲν . . . δέ, **indeed . . . but**, [[40-matthew.3.11|Mat.3:11]], [[42-luke.3.16|Luk.3:16]], al.; with pronouns, ὃς μὲν . . . ὃς δέ, **one . . . another**, [[40-matthew.21.35|Mat.21:35]], al.; pl., [[50-philippians.1.16|Php.1:16, 17]]; ὃ μὲν . . . ὃ δὲ . . . ὃ δέ, some . . . some . . . some, [[40-matthew.13.8|Mat.13:8;]] τοῦτο μὲν . . . τοῦτο δέ, partly . . . partly, [[58-hebrews.10.33|Heb.10:33;]] μὲν . . . ἔπειτα, [[43-john.11.6|Jhn.11:6;]] μὲν . . . καί, [[42-luke.8.5|Luk.8:5.]] 
2. **μέν solitarium, answered by no other particle**: πρῶτον μέν (Bl., l.with), [[45-romans.1.8|Rom.1:8 3:2]], [[46-1-corinthians.11.18|1Co.11:18]]; μὲν οὖν in narrative, summing up what precedes or introducing something further (Bl., §78, 5), **so then, rather, nay rather**: [[42-luke.11.28|Luk.11:28]] (WH, μενοῦν), [[44-acts.1.6|Act.1:6 9:31]], al.; μὲν οὖν γε ([[50-philippians.3.8|Php.3:8]], WH): see: μενοῦνγε.

3361:
**μή**, 
_subjective negative particle_, 
used where the negation depends on a condition or hypothesis, expressed or understood, as distinct from οὐ, which denies absolutely. μή is used where one _thinks_ a thing is not, as distinct from an absolute negation. As a general rule, οὐ negatives the indic, μή the other moods, incl, ptcp. [In LXX for אֵין ,אַיִן ,אַל ] 
I. As a neg. adv., **not**; 
1. with ref. to thought or opinion: [[43-john.3.18|Jhn.3:18]], [[56-titus.1.11|Tit.1:11]], [[61-2-peter.1.9|2Pe.1:9]]. 
2. In delib. questions, with subjc. (M, _Pr._, 185): [[41-mark.12.14|Mrk.12:14]], [[45-romans.3.8|Rom.3:8]]. 
3. **In conditional and final sentences, after εἰ, ἐάν, ἄν, ἵνα, ὅπως**: [[40-matthew.10.14|Mat.10:14]], [[41-mark.6.11|Mrk.6:11 12:19]], [[42-luke.9.5|Luk.9:5]], [[43-john.6.50|Jhn.6:50]], [[45-romans.11.25|Rom.11:25]], al. 
4. C. inf. (see M, _Pr._, 234f., 239, 255), 
(a) after verbs of saying, etc.: [[40-matthew.2.12|Mat.2:12 5:34]], [[41-mark.12.18|Mrk.12:18]], [[44-acts.15.38|Act.15:38]], [[45-romans.2.21|Rom.2:21]], al.; 
(b) with artic. inf.: after a prep., [[40-matthew.13.5|Mat.13:5]], [[41-mark.4.5|Mrk.4:5]], [[44-acts.7.19|Act.7:19]], [[46-1-corinthians.10.6|1Co.10:6]], al.; without a prep., [[45-romans.14.13|Rom.14:13]], [[47-2-corinthians.2.1|2Co.2:1, 13]] [[52-1-thessalonians.4.6|1Th 4:6]]; 
(with) **in sentences expressing consequence, after ὥστε**: [[40-matthew.8.28|Mat.8:28]], [[41-mark.3.20|Mrk.3:20]], [[46-1-corinthians.1.7|1Co.1:7]], [[47-2-corinthians.3.7|2Co.3:7]], al. 
5. C. ptcp. (see M, _Pr._, 231f., 239), in hypothetical references to persons of a certain character or description: [[40-matthew.10.28|Mat.10:28 12:30]], [[42-luke.6.49|Luk.6:49]], [[43-john.3.18|Jhn.3:18]], [[45-romans.4.5|Rom.4:5]], [[46-1-corinthians.7.38|1Co.7:38]], [[62-1-john.3.10|1Jn.3:10]], al.; where the person or thing being definite, the denial is a matter of opinion: [[43-john.6.64|Jhn.6:64]], [[46-1-corinthians.1.28|1Co.1:28 4:7, 18]], [[47-2-corinthians.5.21|2Co.5:21]], al.; where the ptcp. has a concessive, causal or conditional force, **if, though, because not**: [[40-matthew.18.25|Mat.18:25]], [[42-luke.2.45|Luk.2:45]], [[43-john.7.49|Jhn.7:49]], [[44-acts.9.26|Act.9:26]], [[45-romans.2.14|Rom.2:14 5:13]], [[47-2-corinthians.3.14|2Co.3:14]], [[48-galatians.6.9|Gal.6:9]], Ju 5; where the ptcp. has a descriptive force (_being such as_), **not**: [[44-acts.9.9|Act.9:9]], [[45-romans.1.28|Rom.1:28]], [[46-1-corinthians.10.33|1Co.10:33]], [[48-galatians.4.8|Gal.4:8]], [[58-hebrews.12.27|Heb.12:27]], al. 
6. μή prohibitive, in indep. sentences, 
(a) with subjc. praes., 1 of person(s) pl.: [[48-galatians.5.26|Gal.5:26 6:9]], [[52-1-thessalonians.5.6|1Th.5:6]], [[62-1-john.3.18|1Jn.3:18]]; 
(b) with imperat. praes., **usually where one is bidden to desist from what has already begun **(cf. M, _Pr._, 122ff.): [[40-matthew.7.1|Mat.7:1]], [[41-mark.5.36|Mrk.5:36]], [[42-luke.6.30|Luk.6:30]], [[43-john.2.16|Jhn.2:16 5:45]], [[44-acts.10.15|Act.10:15]], [[45-romans.11.18|Rom.11:18]], [[59-james.2.1|Jas.2:1]], [[66-revelation.5.5|Rev.5:5]], al.; 
(with) **forbidding that which is still future**: with imperat. aor., 3 of person(s), [[40-matthew.24.18|Mat.24:18]], [[41-mark.13.15|Mrk.13:15]], [[42-luke.17.31|Luk.17:31]], al.; with subjc. aor., 2 of person(s), [[40-matthew.3.9|Mat.3:9 10:26]], [[41-mark.5.7|Mrk.5:7]], [[42-luke.6.29|Luk.6:29]], [[43-john.3.7|Jhn.3:7]], [[45-romans.10.6|Rom.10:6]], al.; 
(d) with optative, **in wishes**: [[55-2-timothy.4.16|2Ti.4:16]] (LXX); μὴ γένοιτο (see M, _Pr._, 194; Bl., §66, 1), [[42-luke.20.16|Luk.20:16]], [[45-romans.3.3|Rom.3:3]], al.; μή τις, [[41-mark.13.5|Mrk.13:5]], al.
II. As a conj., 
1. after verbs of fearing, caution, etc., **that, lest, perhaps** (M, _Pr._, 192f.): with subjc. praes., [[58-hebrews.12.15|Heb.12:15;]] with subjc. aor., [[40-matthew.24.4|Mat.24:4]], [[41-mark.13.5|Mrk.13:5]], [[42-luke.21.8|Luk.21:8]], [[44-acts.13.40|Act.13:40]], [[48-galatians.5.15|Gal.5:15]], al.; ὅρα μή (see M, _Pr._, 124, 178), elliptically, [[66-revelation.19.10|Rev.19:10 22:9]]; with indic, fut. (M, _Pr._, l.with), [[51-colossians.2.8|Col.2:8.]] 
2. **in order that not**: with subjc. aor., [[41-mark.13.36|Mrk.13:36]], [[47-2-corinthians.8.20|2Co.8:20 12:6]]. 
III. Interrogative, in hesitant questions (M, _Pr._, 170), or **where a negative answer is expected**: [[40-matthew.7.9|Mat.7:9, 10]], [[41-mark.2.19|Mrk.2:19]], [[43-john.3.4|Jhn.3:4]], [[45-romans.3.3|Rom.3:3 10:18, 19]], [[46-1-corinthians.1.13|1Co.1:13]], al.; μή τις, [[42-luke.22.35|Luk.22:35]], al.; before οὐ ([[45-romans.10.17|Rom.10:17]], al. in Pl.), expecting an affirm, ans.; οὐ μή, [[42-luke.18.7|Luk.18:7]], [[43-john.18.11|Jhn.18:11]].
IV. οὐ μή as emphatic negation (cf. M, _Pr._, 188, 190ff.; Bl. §64, 5), **not at all, by no means**: with indic, fut., [[40-matthew.16.22|Mat.16:22]], [[43-john.6.35|Jhn.6:35]], [[58-hebrews.10.17|Heb.10:17]], al.; with subjc. aor., [[40-matthew.24.2|Mat.24:2]], [[41-mark.13.2|Mrk.13:2]], [[42-luke.6.37|Luk.6:37]], [[43-john.13.8|Jhn.13:8]], [[46-1-corinthians.8.13|1Co.8:13]], al.

3385:
**μή-τι **
interrog. particle, **expecting a negative answer**: [[40-matthew.7.16|Mat.7:16 26:22, 25]], [[41-mark.4.21|Mrk.4:21 14:19]], [[42-luke.6.39|Luk.6:39]], [[43-john.8.22|Jhn.8:22 18:35]], [[44-acts.10.47|Act.10:47]], [[47-2-corinthians.12.18|2Co.12:18]], [[59-james.3.11|Jas.3:11]]; in hesitant questions (see M, _Pr._, 170.), μ οὗτός ἐστιν, 
can this be, [[40-matthew.12.23|Mat.12:23]], [[43-john.4.29|Jhn.4:29]]; μ. ἄρα, [[47-2-corinthians.1.17|2Co.1:17;]] On εἰ μήτι ([[42-luke.9.13|Luk.9:13]], cf. Bl., § 65, 6), see: εἰ.
**εἰ**, 
_conjunctive particle_, used in conditions and in indirect questions. 
I. Conditional, **if**; 
1. with indic, expressing a general assumption; 
(a) pres.: before indic, pres., [[40-matthew.11.14|Mat.11:14]], [[45-romans.8.25|Rom.8:25]], al.; before imperat., [[41-mark.4.23|Mrk.4:23 9:22]], [[43-john.15.18|Jhn.15:18]], [[46-1-corinthians.7.9|1Co.7:9]], al.; before fut. indic., [[42-luke.16.31|Luk.16:31]], [[45-romans.8.11|Rom.8:11]], al.; before pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, [[40-matthew.12.26|Mat.12:26]], [[45-romans.4.14|Rom.4:14]], al.; similarly, before impf., [[42-luke.17.6|Luk.17:6]], [[43-john.8.39|Jhn.8:39]]; before quæst., [[40-matthew.6.23|Mat.6:23]], [[43-john.5.47|Jhn.5:47 7:23 8:46]], [[60-1-peter.2.20|1Pe.2:20]]; 
(b) fut.: [[40-matthew.26.33|Mat.26:33]], [[60-1-peter.2.20|1Pe.2:20]]; 
(with) pf.: [[43-john.11.12|Jhn.11:12]], [[45-romans.6.5|Rom.6:5]], al.; 
(d) aor.: [[42-luke.16.11|Luk.16:11 19:8]], [[43-john.13.32|Jhn.13:32, 18:23]], [[66-revelation.20.15|Rev.20:15]], al. 
2. **Where the assumption is certain = ἐπεί**: [[40-matthew.12.28|Mat.12:28]], [[43-john.7.4|Jhn.7:4]], [[45-romans.5.17|Rom.5:17]], al. 
3. Of an unfulfilled condition, with indic, impf., aor. or plpf., before ἄν, with imp. or aor. (see: ἄν, I, i). 
4. C. indic., after verbs denoting wonder, etc., sometimes, but not always, coupled with an element of doubt: [[41-mark.15.44|Mrk.15:44]], [[62-1-john.3.13|1Jn.3:13]], al. 
5. C. indic., as in LXX ([[04-numbers.14.3|Num.14:3]]o, [[09-1-samuel.14.45|1Ki.14:45]], al. = Heb. אִם), in oaths, with the formula of imprecation understood in a suppressed apodosis (WM, 627; Burton, §272): [[41-mark.8.12|Mrk.8:12]], [[58-hebrews.3.11|Heb.3:11]]" (LXX) 4:3 (LXX). 
6. Rarely (cl.) with optative, **to express a merely possible condition**: [[44-acts.24.19|Act.24:19 27:39]], [[46-1-corinthians.14.10|1Co.14:10 15:37]], I Pe3:14, 17. 
II. Interrogative, **if, whether**. 
1. As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: with indic. pres., [[40-matthew.26.63|Mat.26:63]], [[41-mark.15.36|Mrk.15:36]], [[44-acts.19.2|Act.19:2]], [[47-2-corinthians.13.5|2Co.13:5]], al.; fut., [[41-mark.3.2|Mrk.3:2]], [[44-acts.8.22|Act.8:22]], al.; aor., [[41-mark.15.44|Mrk.15:44]], [[46-1-corinthians.1.16|1Co.1:16]], al.; with subjc. aor. (M, _Pr._, 194), [[50-philippians.3.12|Php.3:12.]] 
2. As in LXX (= Heb. אִם and interrog. הֲ, [[01-genesis.17.17|Gen.17:17]], al.; see WM, 639f.; Viteau, i, 22), **in direct questions**: [[41-mark.8.23|Mrk.8:23]] (Tr., WH, txt.), [[42-luke.13.23|Luk.13:23, 22:49]], [[44-acts.19.2|Act.19:2]], al.
III. With other particles. 
1. εἰ ἄρα, εἴγε, εἰ δὲ μήγε, see: ἄρα, γε. 
2. εἰ δὲ καί, **but if also**: [[42-luke.11.18|Luk.11:18;]] **but even if**, [[46-1-corinthians.4.7|1Co.4:7]], [[47-2-corinthians.4.3|2Co.4:3 11:16]]. 
3. εἰ δὲ μή, **but if not, but if otherwise**: [[41-mark.2.21|Mrk.2:21, 22]] [[43-john.14.2|Jhn.14:2]], [[66-revelation.2.5|Rev.2:5]], al. 
4. εἰ καί, **if even, if also, although**: [[41-mark.14.29|Mrk.14:29]], [[42-luke.11.8|Luk.11:8]], [[46-1-corinthians.7.21|1Co.7:21]], [[47-2-corinthians.4.16|2Co.4:16]], [[50-philippians.2.17|Php.2:17]], al. 
5. καὶ εἰ, **even if**, see: καί 
6. εἰ μή, **if not, unless, except, but only**: [[40-matthew.24.22|Mat.24:22]], [[41-mark.2.26|Mrk.2:26 6:5]], [[43-john.9.33|Jhn.9:33]], [[46-1-corinthians.7.17|1Co.7:17]] (**only**), [[48-galatians.1.19|Gal.1:19]] (cf. ἐὰν μή, 2:16; see Hort., _Ja._, xvi); ἐκτὸς εἰ μή, pleonastic (Bl., §65, 6), [[46-1-corinthians.14.5|1Co.14:5 15:2]], [[54-1-timothy.5.19|1Ti.5:19]]. 
7. εἰ μήν = cl. ἦ μήν (M, _Pr._, 46), in oaths, **surely** ([[26-ezekiel.33.27|Eze.33:27]], al.): [[58-hebrews.6.14|Heb.6:14]]. 
8. εἴ πως, **if haply**: [[44-acts.27.12|Act.27:12]], [[45-romans.1.10|Rom.1:10]]. 
9. εἴτε . . . εἴτε, **whether . . . or**; [[45-romans.12.6|Rom.12:6-8]], [[46-1-corinthians.3.22|1Co.3:22 13:8]], al. 
(AS)

3588:
**ὁ**, ἡ, τό, 
_the prepositive article_ (ἄρθρον προτακτικόν), originally a demonstr. pron. (so usually in Hom.), in general corresponding to the Eng. definite article. 
I. As demonstr. pron. 
1. As frequently in Hom., absol., **he (she, it), his** (etc.): [[44-acts.17.28|Act.17:28]] (quoted from the poet Aratus).
2. Distributive, ὁ μὲν . . . ὁ δέ, **the one . . . the other**: [[46-1-corinthians.7.7|1Co.7:7]], [[48-galatians.4.22|Gal.4:22]]; pl., [[44-acts.14.4|Act.14:4, 17:32]], [[50-philippians.1.16|Php.1:16]], al.; οἱ μὲν . . . ἄλλοι δέ, [[40-matthew.16.14|Mat.16:14]], [[43-john.7.12|Jhn.7:12]]; οἱ μεν̀ . . . ὁδέ, [[58-hebrews.7.21|Heb.7:21, 23]].
3. In narration (without ὁ μὲν preceding), ὁ δέ, **but he**: [[40-matthew.2.14|Mat.2:14]], [[41-mark.1.45|Mrk.1:45]], [[42-luke.8.21|Luk.8:21]], [[43-john.9.38|Jhn.9:38]], al. mult. 
II. As prepositive article, **the**, prefixed, 
1. **to nouns unmodified**: ὁ θεός, τὸ φῶς, etc.; to abstract nouns, ἡ σοφία, etc., to pl. nouns which indicate a class, οἱ ἀλώπεκες, foxes, [[40-matthew.8.20|Mat.8:20]], al.; to an individual as representing a class, ὁ ἐργάτης, [[42-luke.10.7|Luk.10:7;]] with nom. = voc. in addresses, [[40-matthew.11.26|Mat.11:26]], [[43-john.19.3|Jhn.19:3]], [[59-james.5.1|Jas.5:1]], al.; to things which pertain to one, ἡ χεῖρ, **his hand**, [[41-mark.3.1|Mrk.3:1;]] to names of persons well known or already mentioned; usually to names of countries (originally adjectives), ἡ Ἰουδαία, etc.
2. **To modified nouns**: with of person(s) pron. genitive, μοῦ, σοῦ, etc.; with poss. pron., ἐμός, σός, etc.; with adj. between the art. and the noun, ὁ ἀγαθὸς ἄνθρωπος, [[40-matthew.12.35|Mat.12:35;]] the noun foll, by adj., both with art., ὁ ποιμὴν ὁ καλός, [[43-john.10.11|Jhn.10:11]] (on ὁ ὄχλος πολύς, [[43-john.12.9|Jhn.12:9]], see M, _Pr._, 84); before adjectival phrases, ἡ κατ᾽ ἐκλογὴν πρόθεσις, [[45-romans.9.11|Rom.9:11.]] 
3. To Other parts of speech used as substantives; 
(a) **neuter adjectives**: τ. ἀγαθόν, etc.;
(b) **cardinal numerals**: ὁ εἶς, οἷ δύο, etc.;
(with) **participles**: ὁ βαπτίζων (= ὁ Βαπτιστής, [[40-matthew.14.2|Mat.14:2]]), [[41-mark.6.14|Mrk.6:14]]; πᾶς ὁ, with ptcp., **every one who**, etc.;
(d) **adverbs**: τὸ πέραν, τὰ νῦν, ὁ ἔσω ἄνθρωπος;
(e) **infinitives**: nom., τὸ θέλειν, [[45-romans.7.18|Rom.7:18]], al.; genitive, τοῦ, after adjectives, ἄξιον τοῦ πορεύεσθαι, [[46-1-corinthians.16.4|1Co.16:4;]] verbs, ἐλαχεν τοῦ θυμιᾶσαι, [[42-luke.1.9|Luk.1:9;]] and frequently in a final sense, ἐξῆλθεν ὁ σπείρειν, [[40-matthew.13.3|Mat.13:3]] (on the artic. inf., see Bl., §71). 
4. In the neut. to sentences, **phrases or single words treated as a quotation**: τὸ Ἐι δύνῃ, [[41-mark.9.23|Mrk.9:23;]] τὸ ἔτι ἅπαξ, [[58-hebrews.12.27|Heb.12:27;]] τὸ ἀνέβη, [[49-ephesians.4.9|Eph.4:9]], al.
5. **To prepositional phrases**: οἱ ἀπὸ Ἰταλίας, [[58-hebrews.13.24|Heb.13:24;]] οἱ ἐκ νόμου, [[45-romans.4.14|Rom.4:14;]] neut. accusative absol., in adverbial phrases, τὸ καθ᾽ ἡμέραν, **daily**, [[42-luke.11.3|Luk.11:3;]] τὸ κατὰ σάρκα, **as regards the flesh**, [[45-romans.9.5|Rom.9:5.]] 
6. To nouns in the genitive, denoting kinship, association, etc.: ὁ τοῦ, **the son of** (unless context indicates a different relationship), [[40-matthew.10.2|Mat.10:2]], al.; τὰ τοῦ θεοῦ, **the things that pertain to God**, [[40-matthew.16.23|Mat.16:23;]] τὰ τῆς εἰρήνης, [[45-romans.14.19|Rom.14:19]] (cf. M, _Pr._, 81ff.; Bl, §§46, 47).
(AS)

**ὅς**, ἥ, ὅ, 
_the postpositive article_ (ἄρθρον ὑποτακτικόν). 
I. As demonstr. pron. = οὗτος, ὅδε, **this, that**, also for αὐτός, chiefly in nom.: ὅς δέ, **but he** (cf. ἦ δὲ ὅς, frequently in Plat.), [[41-mark.15.23|Mrk.15:23]], [[43-john.5.11|Jhn.5:11]]; ὃς μὲν . . . ὃς δέ, **the one . . . the other**, [[40-matthew.21.35|Mat.21:35, 22:5, 25:15]], [[42-luke.23.33|Luk.23:33]], [[44-acts.27.14|Act.27:14]], [[45-romans.14.5|Rom.14:5]], [[46-1-corinthians.11.21|1Co.11:21]], [[47-2-corinthians.2.18|2Co.2:18]], Ju 22; neut., ὃ μὲν . . . ὃ δέ, **the one . . . the other, some . . . some**, [[40-matthew.13.8|Mat.13:8, 23]], [[45-romans.9.21|Rom.9:21]]; ὃς (ὃ) μὲν . . . (ἄλλος (ἄλλο)) . . . ἕτερος, [[41-mark.4.4|Mrk.4:4]], [[42-luke.8.5|Luk.8:5]], [[46-1-corinthians.12.8|1Co.12:8-10]]; οὓς μέν, absol., [[46-1-corinthians.12.28|1Co.12:28;]] ὃς μὲν . . . ὁ δέ, [[45-romans.14.2|Rom.14:2.]]
II. As relat. pron., **who, which, what, that**; 
1. **agreeing in gender with its antecedent, but differently governed as to case**: [[40-matthew.2.9|Mat.2:9]], [[42-luke.9.9|Luk.9:9]], [[44-acts.20.18|Act.20:18]], [[45-romans.2.29|Rom.2:29]], al. mult.
2. **In variation from the common construction**; 
(a) **in gender, agreeing with a noun in apposition to the antecedent**: [[41-mark.15.16|Mrk.15:16]], [[48-galatians.3.16|Gal.3:16]], [[49-ephesians.6.17|Eph.6:17]], al.; constr. ad sensum: [[43-john.6.9|Jhn.6:9]], [[51-colossians.2.19|Col.2:19]], [[54-1-timothy.3.16|1Ti.3:16]], [[66-revelation.13.14|Rev.13:14]], al.; 
(b) in number, constr. ad sensum: [[44-acts.15.36|Act.15:36]], [[61-2-peter.3.1|2Pe.3:1]]; 
(with) **in case, by attraction to the case of the antecedent **(Bl., §50, 2): [[43-john.4.18|Jhn.4:18]], [[44-acts.3.21|Act.3:21]], [[45-romans.15.18|Rom.15:18]], [[46-1-corinthians.6.19|1Co.6:19]], [[49-ephesians.1.8|Eph.1:8]], al. 
3. The neut. ὅ with nouns of other gender and with phrases, **which thing, which term**: [[41-mark.3.17|Mrk.3:17 12:42]], [[43-john.1.39|Jhn.1:39]], [[51-colossians.3.14|Col.3:14]], al.; with a sentence, [[44-acts.2.32|Act.2:32]], [[48-galatians.2.10|Gal.2:10]], [[62-1-john.2.8|1Jn.2:8]], al. 
4. With ellipse of a demonstrative (οὗτος or ἐκεῖνος), **before or after**: before, [[40-matthew.20.23|Mat.20:23]], [[42-luke.7.43|Luk.7:43]], [[45-romans.10.14|Rom.10:14]], al.; after, [[40-matthew.10.38|Mat.10:38]], [[41-mark.9.40|Mrk.9:40]], [[43-john.19.22|Jhn.19:22]], [[45-romans.2.1|Rom.2:1]] al. 
5. **Expressing purpose, end or cause**: [[40-matthew.11.10|Mat.11:10]] (**who = that he may**), [[41-mark.1.2|Mrk.1:2]], [[58-hebrews.12.6|Heb.12:6]] al. 
6. C. prep, as periphrasis for conjc.: ἀνθ᾽ ὧν ( = ἀντὶ τούτων ὧν), **because**, [[42-luke.1.20|Luk.1:20]], al.; **wherefore**, [[42-luke.12.3|Luk.12:3;]] ἐξ οὗ, **since, for that**, [[45-romans.5.12|Rom.5:12;]] ἀφ᾽ οὗ, **since** (temporal), [[42-luke.13.25|Luk.13:25;]] ἐξ οὗ, **whence**, [[50-philippians.3.20|Php.3:20;]] etc. 
7. **With particles**: ὃς ἄν (ἐάν), see: ἄν, ἐάν; ὃς καί, [[41-mark.3.19|Mrk.3:19]], [[43-john.21.20|Jhn.21:20]], [[45-romans.5.2|Rom.5:2]], al.; ὃς καὶ αὐτός, [[40-matthew.27.57|Mat.27:57.]]
